content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. At Sonar, the SDR role is a launchpad. In 2026 alone, we’ve promoted 8 SDRs globally into SMB and Mid-Market Account Executive roles. We’re intentional about developing our SDRs and preparing them for what comes next. Every SDR follows a structured Professional Development Plan with clear qualitative and quantitative milestones, so you know what success looks like, how you’re progressing, and what it takes to reach your next role. You’ll build the skills, track record, and support you need to step into a quota-carrying career.

About the Role The Director of EMEA North (UK and Ireland as well as Nordic countries) will play a pivotal leadership role in driving Sonar’s growth and success across these regions. As organizations rapidly adopt AI-assisted development and agentic workflows, you will lead a high-performing sales team to position Sonar as an essential foundation for modern software delivery. You will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies to achieve revenue targets, expanding market share, and driving software sales across diverse industries including finance, software, business services, media & internet, and other key sectors.

Why should I Apply: At Sonar, we’re a group of brilliant, motivated, and driven professionals working hard to help organizations build responsible, secure, high-quality code quickly and systematically. We build solutions that don’t just solve symptoms of problems – we fix problems at the source – source code, to be specific. We have a dynamic culture with employees worldwide and hub offices in the USA, Switzerland, the UK, Singapore, and Germany. We believe team members should have the opportunity to come to work every day, work on a product they are proud of, love what they do, and feel energized by their peers. With our roots deep in the open source community, we’re all about the mission: provide solutions that deliver Clean Code. The impact you will have The Sonar Solutions Engineering team is dedicated to helping our prospective customers achieve technical success with our products. This is your chance to join a growing team as we scale up our efforts to have maximum impact on our targeted customer base. As a Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll play a central role in providing deep technical expertise to our prospects and supporting them in evaluating our solution.
